_comment: Country-keyed registry of WHICH local body holds land/water power. A country absent here is not harvested - silence beats guessing. desc must contain {unit}. Populate source descriptors from Actions where the network is open.

county.desc: WHAT IT DOES: the conservation district covering {unit}, a unit of local government with statutory standing on soil, water and related natural resources. Most boards are wholly or partly ELECTED locally and meetings are public. USE IT: the district can generate soil, water and erosion evidence and put it before county decision-makers, and the seats are contested by almost nobody.
